name: cnsplots-v2
summary: Publication-quality scientific figures in Python following Cell Press standards: Cell 10-color palette, Arial typography, ~100 px/pt panel proportions, and dual execution modes (native cnsplots or pure matplotlib/seaborn via cns_cell.mplstyle).

changes: Exported complete cnsplots Cell style as standalone styles/cns_cell.mplstyle for zero-dependency fallback.
Added proactive environment branching: prompt user to choose between installing cnsplots or using pure mplstyle.
Enforced ~100 px/pt (80, 100, 120, 150) panel sizing baseline and strict prohibition of font/marker manual overrides.
Prioritized Cell Press qualitative 10-color palette globally.
Prioritized Arial sans-serif typography across all templates and workflows.
Streamlined architecture into clean styles, scripts, templates, and focused references, removing redundant files.
